children: Tetra Tech shares rose after the company gave an optimistic view for the fiscal year ahead.
The stock rose 10% to $41.70 a share after hours.

The water infrastructure company said it expects revenue in its new fiscal year to be $4.43 billion to $4.63 billion, with earnings per share of $1.65 to $1.80. Analysts polled by FactSet were projecting $4.47 billion in revenue and $1.73 a share in earnings.

For the first fiscal quarter, Tetra Tech expects $1.04 billion to $1.08 billion in sales and 36 cents to 38 cents a share in earnings. That compares with Wall Street estimates of $1.05 billion in revenue and 37 cents a share in earnings.
During the just-ended fourth quarter, revenue net of subcontractor costs increased 5% to $1.15 billion. That was roughly in line with analyst projections.
Adjusted earnings were 49 cents a share, two cents higher than analysts expected.
